title: Iconography / UI icons — Design

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; visible default tab states

slide_intent: Construct small symbols consistently so viewers can recognize meaning quickly without visual weight or shape differences becoming distractions.
strategic_value: Shared grid construction and details related to IBM Plex can make interface icons feel like part of the same IBM visual language.
demonstration: The webpage specifies the UI-icon grid, padding, key shapes, style, strokes, perspective, corners and angles, with explanatory text and green/red comparison panels.
practical_value: Draw an icon on the 32px grid, then check weight, clearance and metaphor-specific geometry instead of forcing every shape into one outline.

content_islands.name: Introduction and resources
content_islands.spec: Place the icon-purpose statement and starter/library cards above the foundation explanation and video area.

content_islands.name: Grid and padding
content_islands.spec: Follow the 32px grid with alignment and arrow-point comparisons, then the 2px padding diagram and related comparisons.

content_islands.name: Key shapes and style
content_islands.spec: Place proportion guidance before the style film and characteristic labels connecting icons with Plex letterforms.

content_islands.name: Strokes and perspective
content_islands.spec: Pair uniform-weight and objective-viewpoint guidance with accepted/rejected specimen fields.

content_islands.name: Corners and angles
content_islands.spec: End with printer, arrow and scissors-related comparisons illustrating shape-specific corners and angle decisions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction explains at-a-glance communication; foundation text connects a shared grid to consistent proportions and positioning.
reference_purposes.Application: The page specifies a 32px grid, 2px padding, default 2px strokes and corners, plus angle guidance and metaphor-specific adjustments.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Mixed stroke weights within one icon are rejected; dimensional perspective is avoided. Complex/dense icons may justify stroke exceptions, and corner radii can increase in multiples of two.
reference_purposes.Expression: Black-and-white icon specimens, blue construction grids and enlarged letterform-related details show the system’s consistent geometry and stroke character.

ingredient.name: UI icon construction
ingredient.role: Maintain legible, balanced symbols at small sizes.
ingredient.application: Use the 32px grid, 2px padding and default 2px stroke; preserve uniform visual weight while allowing the stated dense-icon and metaphor-specific exceptions.
ingredient.scope: IBM UI icons, not app icons or pictograms. The page permits limited padding extensions for required detail or visual weight and does not require 45° angles for every shape.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
